svg.title: AlSaeed sample certificate of completion for PMP exam preparation training
svg.desc: A purple and gold sample training certificate. Participant name and completion date are placeholders. Original decorative script signatures read Mohamed Attia and AlSaeed. A gold AlSaeed sample seal sits between them. This is not a PMI-issued PMP credential.

g.aria-label: This sample certificate is presented to
for successfully completing the AlSaeed training program
Sample training certificate · Not a PMI-issued PMP® credential
